places.name: Brooklyn, New York
places.what: Born in Brooklyn to Russian-Jewish immigrant parents. The map point represents the borough, not a particular birth address.

sources.title: Library of Congress, George and Ira Gershwin Collection finding aid, biographical note, p. 5

places.name: Manhattan, New York
places.what: Left school to work as a song plugger for Jerome H. Remick and Company, earning fifteen dollars a week; left the job in March 1917.

sources.title: Library of Congress finding aid, biographical note, pp. 6–7

places.name: Columbia University, New York
places.what: Took summer courses in nineteenth-century Romantic music and elementary orchestration with Rossetter G. Cole.

sources.title: Library of Congress finding aid, biographical note, p. 7

places.name: London
places.what: Made his first European visit to supervise The Rainbow, which opened at the Empire Theatre on 3 April.

sources.title: Library of Congress finding aid, biographical note, p. 8

places.name: New York
places.what: Played the piano at the first performance of Rhapsody in Blue, with Paul Whiteman and his orchestra at Aeolian Hall.

sources.title: Jim Farrington, Library of Congress National Recording Registry essay on Rhapsody in Blue

places.name: New York
places.what: Played his Concerto in F at Carnegie Hall with Walter Damrosch conducting the New York Symphony Society.

sources.title: Library of Congress finding aid, biographical note, p. 8

places.name: Paris
places.what: Visited during the European trip that began in March; worked on An American in Paris and sought taxi horns for its orchestra.

sources.title: Library of Congress finding aid, biographical note, p. 9
Gershwin official catalogue, An American in Paris

places.name: Boston
places.what: Played the Second Rhapsody at Symphony Hall with the Boston Symphony Orchestra and Serge Koussevitzky.

places.name: Havana
places.what: Holiday in Cuba supplied the experience behind the Cuban Overture, first performed in New York that August as Rumba.

sources.title: Library of Congress finding aid, biographical note, p. 10
Orrin Howard, Los Angeles Philharmonic, Cuban Overture

places.name: Folly Beach, South Carolina
places.what: Stayed on Folly Beach during the summer while working with DuBose Heyward on Porgy and Bess; the Heywards also had a cottage there.

sources.title: South Carolina Historical Society, October 1935: The opera Porgy and Bess opens in New York

places.name: Boston
places.what: Porgy and Bess opened its pre-Broadway engagement at the Colonial Theatre, with Todd Duncan and Anne Brown in the title roles.

sources.title: Library of Congress finding aid, biographical note, p. 10

places.name: New York
places.what: Porgy and Bess opened at the Alvin Theatre; its original Broadway run lasted 124 performances.

sources.title: Gershwin official catalogue, Porgy and Bess

places.name: Los Angeles
places.what: Moved to California with Ira and Leonore Gershwin; the brothers wrote film scores including Shall We Dance, A Damsel in Distress and The Goldwyn Follies.

sources.title: Library of Congress finding aid, biographical note, pp. 10–11

places.name: Los Angeles
places.what: Died of a brain tumour at thirty-eight.
